items.micro_skill: draw only what must follow from two statements
items.stem: Statement 1: All licensed midwives are registered health workers. Statement 2: All registered health workers are listed in the provincial health roster. Which conclusion follows?

options.text: All licensed midwives are listed in the provincial health roster.
Some registered health workers are not licensed midwives.
All people in the provincial health roster are licensed midwives.
No licensed midwives are listed in the provincial health roster.

reveal.terms: A syllogism links two statements through a shared middle group. A valid conclusion must be true in every picture the statements allow.
reveal.shortcut: Draw the groups as circles: put the first group inside the second, then test each conclusion.
reveal.why_correct: Statement 1 puts one group inside the middle group, and Statement 2 says how the middle group relates to the last group. So "All licensed midwives are listed in the provincial health roster." must be true; nothing else is guaranteed.

why_wrong.o2: This may or may not be true; the statements do not decide it.
why_wrong.o3: This reverses the statement; "all A are B" does not mean "all B are A".
why_wrong.o4: This claims more than the statements give, or contradicts them.
